text.en: Dog owners regularly highlight the welcoming attitude and attentiveness of the team at Miramar. Reviews praise staff members for handling energetic dogs with patience and ensuring consistent supervision throughout daily playgroups. Clients note that handlers appear genuinely invested in each pet's comfort and emotional wellbeing.

Pet parents observe that dogs settle quickly into structured pack play and return home tired and contented. The environment accommodates both first-time daycare visitors and long-term regulars, giving pets ample opportunity to burn off energy. Several owners emphasise that even nervous dogs gradually gain confidence around other canines.

Clients appreciate the live webcam feeds, which allow them to observe their dogs playing and resting during daycare stays. Reviewers also point out the convenience of early morning and late evening opening hours, which comfortably suit long work shifts. The indoor play areas and quiet resting spaces receive steady compliments.

q.en: Can owners monitor their dogs online during daycare?

a.en: Yes, clients can check in on their pets via live room webcams accessible through the mobile app during play hours.

q.en: Are the operating hours suitable for long work shifts?

a.en: Reviewers note that the Miramar facility provides extended hours that accommodate healthcare workers and other clients working twelve-hour shifts.

q.en: Are spa and grooming treatments available during daycare stays?

a.en: Yes, pet parents report that bath and spa add-ons can be arranged so dogs are clean and fresh upon collection.

q.en: How are dogs supervised during group play?

a.en: Clients observe via webcams that dedicated attendants remain in the rooms to monitor play styles and maintain calm interactions.
